is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L1014F, L1014S, N1575Y, and Ace-1 G119S (page 4, Methods; page 8, Table 2 and Table 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 and Table 3 provide allele frequencies and sample sizes (N) for the genotyped markers.

african_field_population.evidence: The study collected Anopheles larvae from eight field sites in Ghana (page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study involving field collection, bioassays, and molecular analysis.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides specific site names and coordinates (e.g., Tuba, Opeibea, Nima, Teshie, Kpalsogu, Libga, Taha, Kulaa) (page 2, Methods).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted in 2025-2026 (page 1, header; page 13, Received/Accepted dates).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new field collections and surveys conducted by the authors.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and frequencies, are provided in the main text tables (Table 2, Table 3, Table 4).

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. across eight sites in Ghana. It combined WHO susceptibility bioassays with molecular genotyping of kdr (L1014F, L1014S, N1575Y) and Ace-1 (G119S) mutations. The study also surveyed household and agricultural pesticide use to assess their contribution to resistance.
